note: Run each prompt with the skill and with the previous version or no skill. Grade every assertion as pass or fail from the transcript and the resulting diff. A good assertion fails without the skill. should_trigger prompts must load this skill. should_not_trigger prompts are near misses that belong to another skill and must not load this one.

evals.prompt: We added a blog. Only some posts are translated into Japanese and Arabic. Set up the SEO for the posts.
assertions: Emits hreflang only among posts that have a reviewed translation
Gives each translation a self-canonical and does not canonicalize to English
Refuses to create locale URLs that render the default language
Uses BlogPosting or Article JSON-LD from the same data as the visible byline and dates
Sets lastModified from the content date and never from new Date()
Does not add FAQ markup for a rich result
Reports what is verified locally and what needs Search Console

should_trigger: Only half our posts are translated into Japanese. What do we emit for hreflang on the untranslated ones?
Should our Spanish pages use es or es-MX? Most of our customers are in Mexico but we also get Spain.
Can we redirect visitors to their browser language automatically on the homepage without hurting SEO?
The client wants to machine translate the whole site into six languages overnight. Is that fine for search?
Our /de pages canonicalize to the English page. Is that right?
Google shows the English snippet to German users even though a /de page exists. What could cause that?
Is the language switcher enough for crawlers to find our Arabic pages, or do we need something else?
We are launching in Brazil next quarter. Do we need pt-BR separate from pt-PT?
How do I keep the hreflang tags in the HTML and in the sitemap identical?
should_not_trigger: Add a message with a plural in five languages.
Why is my sitemap missing half the pages?
Block AI crawlers from training on the site.
Our Arabic pages lost 40 percent of clicks last month according to Search Console.
How do I format a price in euros for the German locale with next-intl?
Write Product JSON-LD for a shoe with two sizes.
The /fr page returns 404 in production. Fix the routing.
Plan a content calendar for the blog.
